snippet.title: The Cinderling Early Development Trailer
snippet.description:
The Cinderling - Early Development Trailer
Do you love cozy hand drawn games? Blacksmiths? Folklore?

The Cinderling is an immersive, rhythmic blacksmith and shop keeper game.
Stay in sync with the music and lose yourself in the rhythmic ring of hammered iron!
Complete mini-games and feel the heat of the cracking coals, work the bellows to push the flames and strike the anvil in perfect time.
Explore a narrative rich world and get to know the eccentric customers and the reasons behind their weird requests. 
Uncover the secrets of the forge. 
And break the curse that binds you!

Join The Cinderling discord and get access to play our early development demo and become a part of shaping our game! 
#gametok #cozygames #indiegamedev #rhythmgame #indiegames
